summary: Completed frontend testing of İşçi QR kod oxutma sistemi (Worker QR Code Scanning System). Tested worker login, admin login, admin dashboard, Real Time Monitoring tab, and QR code functionality.

integration_issues.issue: Admin session expires quickly, causing redirects back to login form during navigation

passed_tests: İşçi giriş formu (/workers) loads correctly with email and password fields
Admin giriş formu (/workers/admin-login) loads correctly with proper form fields
Admin login authentication works with provided credentials (rasimgasimzade@gmail.com)
Admin dashboard loads successfully with navigation tabs
Real Vaxt İzləmə tab opens and displays QR code functionality
QR code is generated and displayed in admin panel
Worker login form shows proper error handling for invalid credentials
Navigation between worker and admin login forms works
Admin dashboard shows statistics cards (Bugün İşdə, Gecikənlər, etc.)
Real Time Monitoring shows worker status filters and worker list
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix admin session management - sessions expire too quickly causing navigation issues. Consider implementing proper Firebase auth persistence or extending session timeout.
